''See also: [[Lilia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lilia is a wooden doll characterized by large purple eyes and a frilly white dress. She is part of a collection of dolls owned by [[Kai]], who treats her with significant care. Lilia possesses the ability to communicate telepathically, often speaking in a manner that sounds like a gentle [[wind]]. Her voice is typically described as distant, thoughtful, or dreamy, though she can also express curiosity or observation. While she provides various pieces of advice and commentary to those around her, she has expressed a sense of resignation regarding whether people actually follow her guidance. In one instance, she was depicted with crushed feet and a damaged dress while being carried by [[Angeline]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lilia is a doll wearing a white dress that has been torn. She possesses large purple eyes and has crushed feet.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|She communicates with [[Simon]] and is known to make him feel bad regarding a poor throw. Her speech consists of incomprehensible remarks about [[dreams]], delivered in a voice that trails off.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Kai]] addresses Lilia as one of his dolls. She also maintains communication with [[Simon]], who carries her in his arm and is subject to her making him feel bad about poor throws. Additionally, [[Rebekkah]] mimics the dreamy tones of Lilia's voice.}}
